body: Classification of the original visible signal in 28 cases (some count twice). (1) Policy or regulation creates or reshapes an industry, 7 cases: vannamei legalisation Apr 2009 (Avanti), mobile PLI Oct 2020 (Dixon), defence indigenisation and orders such as the Tejas contract Feb 2021 (HAL, BEL, shipyards), SEBI one-expiry-per-exchange Nov 2024 (BSE), formalisation and hallmarking (Titan). (2) Capex commissioning or new technology visible in filings, 5: Deepak phenol plant (Nov 2018), APL Apollo DFT lines (2016–17), Balkrishna Bhuj, Alkyl capacity, La Opala Sitarganj. (3) Mix shift where profit grows faster than revenue, 5: Garware value-added products 35%→75%, Eicher/Royal Enfield, Caplin margins, Tata Elxsi 2014–15, Trent Zudio. (4) Management change or focus, 3: Bajaj Finance CEO 2007, Eicher divesting 13 of 15 businesses (2004–05), Suzlon equity repair 2022–23. (5) Free, frequent industry data, 3: CDSL demat counts, BSE options premium share, Trent store/LFL updates. (6) Panic mispricing of a known compounder, about 14 (see insight:india-mb-crisis-start). Most signals were public 6–24 months before EPS showed them, and in categories 1–3 the stock usually still traded at P/E <15. Process: monitor policy notifications, capex completion dates, segment mix and monthly industry series for the watchlist, then check the starting multiple. Category counts are judgement calls.
title: Six kinds of early signal behind Indian multibaggers (with counts)
